summary: The agent successfully builds machine learning models and extracts basic features from text and date columns. However, it makes a critical error by treating free-text columns as categorical features and ignores the temporal order of the data by using random K-Fold cross-validation. Furthermore, it naively ensembles the models and fails to report any validation scores to estimate out-of-sample performance.
